name: Mirror Palais
production_model: Designed in NYC, made in the US, China and India

prices.note: products.json serves 131 published items in the dresses collection (collections.json says 412); 75 are regular-price dresses and gowns (no compare_at above price). Excluded: 33 'Sample' and 'Muslin Sample' items (Archive Sale 2026, final sale), 1 marked-down dress, skirts, tops, bustiers, bikinis, a gift card and a $0 Custom Order. Items tagged 'Summer Sale 2026' with no markdown are counted as regular price. Low: Lady Di A-Line Dress in Noir $395; top: Cascading Ruffle Gown in Pearl $5,995. Median $995. Many $595 pieces: Classic Supermodel Dress, La Piscine Mini Dress, Maria Micro Mini Dress. Plunging Back Cowl Dress $1,495 (made to order).

notes: About: 'Queens-born Marcelo Gaia founded Mirror Palais in 2019, after working for almost a decade as a stylist, with the mission to create dreamy, nostalgic pieces'; 'many items are made from vintage fabrics leading to limited launches and made-to-order exclusives'; 'Every garment is designed in New York'. Homepage title: 'Silk Dresses, Corsets & Romantic Womenswear'. known_for built from 'dreamy, nostalgic pieces' and its dresses (412 of 762 items in Shop All are in Dresses).
meta.json: shop address New York, US; currency USD; ships_to_countries includes '*', US, CA, GB, AU.
Size guide: XXS (bust 29-30, waist 22-23 in) to XXL (bust 45-46, waist 38-39 in). Product size options label XXS as 'XXS (PETITE)', so has_petite true; no plus range past XXL.

Product pages: Lady Di A-Line Dress and Classic Supermodel Dress 'made in New York City, USA'; Maria Dress and Plunging Back Cowl Dress 'made in Shenzhen, China'; La Piscine Mini Dress 'made in Mumbai, India'; Diamond Dust Mini Dress 'made in New Delhi, India'. Many sizes are pre-order or made-to-order (Plunging Back Cowl: 'expected to ship within 3-4 months').

Shipping page: in-stock pieces ship in 5 to 10 business days (processing 10 to 15 business days); made-to-order pieces 'could take 3 to 6 months'; pre-order times per product. US orders UPS Ground, 1-5 business days, cost shown at checkout (no free-shipping threshold stated). International via DHL Express; recipient pays import fees. 24-hour cancellation window, 'No refunds, no exceptions past the 24-hour cancellation window'. In-person try-ons for in-stock pieces at its NYC office by appointment.

Returns policy: 'We do not offer refunds for returned items. No Exceptions.' Store credit or limited exchanges for unworn garments within 14 days of receipt; customer pays return shipping; sale items and custom pieces final sale. returns_days 14 is for store credit or exchange only.
Stockists page: FWRD, Moda Operandi, REVOLVE online; Desordre boutiques in Australia. No US store of its own (NYC office try-ons by appointment), so us_stores left empty.
Collections include Archive Sale 2026, Sample Sale, Last Chance Sale: sale_pattern 'Archive and sample sales'.
